eligible_occupation: Coffee grower / Farmer
eligible_location: Coffee-growing regions in India, subject to Coffee Board eligibility
other_conditions: Eligible SC, ST and other growers; land must be suitable for coffee cultivation; land records must be in the applicant's name; seeds/seedlings must be obtained from the Coffee Board or approved nodal agency.

maximum_annual_income: No fixed income limit; government exclusion criteria apply
eligible_occupation: Landholding farmer families
other_conditions: Cultivable agricultural land must be recorded in the name of eligible farmer family members. Government exclusion criteria apply.

eligible_occupation: Student
other_conditions: Must be entering Class 9 in a government, government-aided or local body school. Must have at least 55% marks in Class 7 (50% for SC/ST students) and qualify in the state selection test.

maximum_annual_income: No income limit for senior citizens aged 70+
eligible_occupation: All occupations
other_conditions: Poor and vulnerable families identified under scheme eligibility criteria are eligible. All senior citizens aged 70 years or above are eligible regardless of income.

maximum_annual_income: Below ₹8 lakh (one of the alternative eligibility categories, not compulsory for everyone)
eligible_occupation: Pregnant and lactating women
other_conditions: Must belong to at least one eligible social or economic category, such as SC/ST, BPL, e-Shram cardholder or MGNREGA worker. Benefits depend on pregnancy and childbirth conditions.

maximum_annual_income: ₹9 lakh (MIG category; EWS up to ₹3 lakh, LIG ₹3–6 lakh, MIG ₹6–9 lakh)
eligible_occupation: All occupations
other_conditions: Applicant's family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India. Must meet the income and other conditions of the applicable scheme component.

eligible_occupation: Street vendors
other_conditions: Must be an eligible street vendor identified through a Certificate of Vending (CoV), Letter of Recommendation (LoR), or verification by the local authority.

eligible_occupation: Student
other_conditions: Must have passed Class 12 and scored above the 80th percentile in the relevant board examination. Must be pursuing a regular recognised college or university course and must not be receiving another scholarship.

eligible_occupation: Entrepreneurs; women and SC/ST applicants
other_conditions: Applicant must be a woman or belong to the SC/ST category. The loan is for setting up a greenfield (first-time) enterprise. For non-individual enterprises, at least 51% ownership and controlling stake must be held by a woman or SC/ST entrepreneur.

eligible_occupation: Traditional artisans and craftspeople
other_conditions: Must work independently in one of the 18 notified traditional trades. Only one family member can register. Government employees and their family members are not eligible. Restrictions apply to applicants who have taken similar government business loans in the previous five years.

eligible_occupation: Residential electricity consumers
other_conditions: Applicant must be a residential electricity consumer with a suitable rooftop for solar installation. The electricity connection should be in the applicant's household name or meet the applicable requirements.

eligible_occupation: All eligible Indian citizens; especially unorganised-sector workers
other_conditions: Must have a savings bank or post office account. People who are or have been income-tax payers cannot join from 1 October 2022.

eligible_occupation: Students
other_conditions: Must be enrolled in Bal Vatika or Classes I–VIII in a Government or Government-aided school.

eligible_occupation: Girl child
other_conditions: A parent or legal guardian must open the account. Maximum two girl children per family (exceptions for twins/triplets). Only one account per girl child.

eligible_occupation: Any adult willing to do unskilled manual work
other_conditions: Applicant must be an adult member of a rural household. Household registration and a Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Card are required. Provides up to 125 days of guaranteed wage employment per household per financial year.

eligible_occupation: Unorganised-sector workers such as street vendors, domestic workers, agricultural labourers and construction workers
other_conditions: Must not be covered under EPFO, ESIC or NPS (Government-funded), and must not be an income-tax payer. Must have an Aadhaar card and savings bank or Jan Dhan account.

eligible_occupation: Farmers, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers
other_conditions: Must grow a notified crop in a notified area and have an insurable interest in the crop. Land records or relevant cultivation documents may be required.

maximum_annual_income: No fixed annual income limit; family must be BPL
eligible_occupation: BPL households whose primary breadwinner has died
other_conditions: The deceased must have been the primary breadwinner of the family. A homemaker may also be considered a breadwinner. The surviving eligible household member can receive one-time financial assistance of ₹20,000.

maximum_annual_income: No fixed income limit; applicant must belong to a poor household
eligible_occupation: Women from eligible poor households
other_conditions: No existing LPG connection should be present in the household. Applicant must belong to an eligible category such as SC/ST, AAY, PMAY-G beneficiary, forest dweller or another qualifying poor household under the prescribed declaration.

eligible_occupation: Students, school/college dropouts, unemployed youth and people seeking skill training
other_conditions: Must be an Indian national with valid Aadhaar. Eligibility and educational qualifications depend on the selected course. RPL applicants must have prior experience in the relevant skill.

maximum_annual_income: Not annual-income based; monthly wage ceiling ₹1,00,000
eligible_occupation: First-time formal-sector employees registered with EPFO
other_conditions: Must join an eligible establishment between 1 August 2025 and 31 July 2027. Must not have been an EPFO contributing member before 1 August 2025. EPFO contributions and required UAN authentication are necessary.

eligible_occupation: ITI pass-outs, vocational trainees, graduates, diploma holders and eligible fresh apprentices
other_conditions: Must meet the educational and physical requirements of the selected trade, register on the Apprenticeship Portal and have an apprenticeship contract. Aadhaar is required.

maximum_annual_income: No fixed income limit; targets rural poor households
eligible_occupation: Rural women, self-help groups (SHGs) and rural poor households
other_conditions: Primarily aims to organise rural poor women into Self-Help Groups. SHGs generally have 10–20 members and must follow prescribed group rules to receive financial assistance.

eligible_occupation: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, fish vendors and fisheries-related businesses
other_conditions: Individual beneficiaries or eligible fisheries enterprises must meet the conditions of the relevant scheme component. Registration on the National Fisheries Digital Platform (NFDP) is required for applicable benefits.

eligible_occupation: Any Indian citizen, especially unbanked individuals
other_conditions: Applicant should not already have a bank account for opening a new PMJDY account. A basic savings account can be opened at a bank branch or Bank Mitra outlet. KYC documents are required.

eligible_occupation: All eligible individuals
other_conditions: Must have an individual savings bank or post office account in a participating institution and give consent for annual premium auto-debit. Only one policy per person is allowed. Coverage can continue up to age 55 with regular renewal.

eligible_occupation: All eligible individuals
other_conditions: Must have an individual savings bank or post office account in a participating institution and give consent for annual premium auto-debit. Only one account can be used for enrolment.

maximum_annual_income: No fixed income limit for all components
eligible_occupation: Senior citizens
other_conditions: Must be an Indian senior citizen aged 60 or above. Specific benefits, such as assistive devices under Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana, have additional income and disability conditions.

maximum_annual_income: No fixed annual income limit; eligibility depends on NFSA household classification
eligible_occupation: Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH) ration-card holders
other_conditions: Must be identified as an eligible NFSA beneficiary and hold a valid AAY or PHH ration card. Food grains are received through the existing ration card at a Fair Price Shop.

maximum_annual_income: ₹3,60,000 per year (monthly family income up to ₹30,000)
eligible_occupation: Persons with disabilities
other_conditions: Must have at least 40% disability and a UDID card or UDID enrolment number with disability certificate. Must not have received assistance for the same purpose during the previous 3 years.

eligible_occupation: Rural households
other_conditions: The mission aims to provide Functional Household Tap Connections (FHTC) to every rural household. Water supply should meet prescribed quality and quantity standards and be available regularly.

maximum_annual_income: No fixed income limit; household category determines toilet incentive eligibility
eligible_occupation: Rural households
other_conditions: For individual household toilet incentive, household must be a new eligible BPL household or an identified APL household belonging to SC/ST, small or marginal farmers, landless labourers with homestead, households with a person with disability, or women-headed households. Final approval is through local authorities.

maximum_annual_income: No fixed income limit; applicant must belong to a poor rural household
eligible_occupation: Unemployed rural youth seeking skill training and employment
other_conditions: Must belong to an eligible poor rural household. Upper age limit is 45 years for women, persons with disabilities, PVTGs and other specified special groups.

maximum_annual_income: OBC: Below ₹3 lakh; EBC: Below ₹1 lakh; SC, DNT and Safai Karamcharis: No income limit
eligible_occupation: SC, OBC, EBC, DNT candidates and Safai Karamcharis, including waste pickers
other_conditions: Must belong to an eligible category, have Aadhaar and an Aadhaar-linked bank account (subject to applicable exemptions), and meet the selected course requirements.

eligible_occupation: Farmers, groups of farmers, cooperatives, FPOs and other eligible farmer organisations
other_conditions: Eligibility depends on the component. Farmers can apply for solar agricultural pumps, solarisation of existing grid-connected pumps or solar power plants on eligible land. State implementing agency and DISCOM conditions apply.

eligible_occupation: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, fish vendors, fisheries entrepreneurs, SHGs and cooperatives
other_conditions: Must be directly involved in fisheries or aquaculture, or belong to an eligible fisheries organisation. Component-specific conditions, project approval and registration requirements apply.

maximum_annual_income: ₹8 lakh (family income limit, subject to scheme rules)
eligible_occupation: Unemployed youth and eligible final-year graduate/postgraduate students
other_conditions: Must be an Indian national. Must not be in full-time employment. Final-year students need an institution-issued No Objection Certificate (NOC). Family members must not include a permanent government employee. Certain qualifications and institutions are excluded under scheme rules.

eligible_occupation: Scheduled Caste (SC) students pursuing post-matric or post-secondary education
other_conditions: Must be an Indian national belonging to the SC category recognised in the applicant's state or UT. Must have passed Class 10 or an equivalent examination and be enrolled in a recognised post-matric course. Must not receive another scholarship simultaneously.

eligible_occupation: SC students, Denotified/Nomadic/Semi-Nomadic Tribes, landless agricultural labourers and traditional artisans
eligible_location: India (for eligible Indian applicants studying abroad)
other_conditions: Must have at least 60% marks or equivalent in the qualifying examination and an unconditional admission offer from an eligible foreign university. Scholarship is for Master's and PhD courses.

eligible_occupation: Entrepreneurs, unemployed youth and individuals planning to start a new micro-enterprise
other_conditions: Only new eligible non-farm projects qualify. For projects above ₹10 lakh in manufacturing or ₹5 lakh in service/business, at least Class 8 pass is required. Only one person per family can receive assistance. Existing units that have already received government subsidy are generally not eligible.

maximum_annual_income: No general income limit; preventive sponsorship has separate income criteria
eligible_occupation: Children in need of care and protection, vulnerable children and children in conflict with law
other_conditions: Must fall under an eligible child-protection category. Support may include institutional care, sponsorship, foster care, adoption or aftercare. Eligibility depends on assessment by the relevant Child Welfare Committee or authority.

maximum_annual_income: No fixed income limit; eligibility depends on state category and beneficiary category
eligible_occupation: Pregnant women
other_conditions: In Low Performing States (including Uttar Pradesh), all pregnant women delivering at eligible government health centres can qualify. In High Performing States, BPL, SC and ST women qualify under prescribed conditions. Additional conditions apply for accredited private hospitals.

eligible_occupation: Rural households without a pucca house
other_conditions: Household must be houseless or live in a kutcha house with zero, one or two rooms. Must be identified through the SECC/Awaas+ beneficiary list and verified by the Gram Sabha. Government exclusion criteria apply, including specified income, vehicle, land and employment conditions.

eligible_occupation: Poorest households, including landless labourers, marginal farmers, rural artisans and informal-sector workers
other_conditions: Must belong to an eligible poorest household identified by the State Government. Priority categories include destitute households, certain elderly or disabled-headed households without support, single women or men without support, and eligible tribal households.

eligible_occupation: Micro food processing entrepreneurs, SHGs, FPOs and cooperatives
other_conditions: Individual applicant must own an eligible micro food processing enterprise. Individual units should generally be unincorporated and employ fewer than 10 workers. Minimum 10% beneficiary contribution and bank loan are required for individual credit-linked subsidy. Group applications have separate conditions.
